title: Automated installed-update inventory and patch closure need deployment evidence
remediation: Release maintainers and deployment patch operators map scoped supported component and firmware versions to security updates. Validate applicable fixes in a representative test environment and prove an automated deployment inventory distinguishes applied, overdue and excepted updates. Keep release dependency observations and approved deployment exceptions with their dated remediation result.

milestones.title: Collect component update inventory, automated results showing applied and outstanding updates, and a sampled update and retest
